source_text:
{Note that a Hilbert complex is more than just a complex in which the spaces are Hilbert. At each level, there are two Hilbert spaces: the base space $W^k$ and the domain space, which we shall denote by $V^k$. Since we assume that the differentials $d^k$ are closed, the domain spaces $V^k$ are Hilbert spaces with the graph norm}
\[
\|v\|_{V^k}^2=\|v\|_{W^k}^2+\|d^k v\|_{W^{k+1}}^2.
\]
translated_text:
{注意, Hilbert 复形并不仅仅是各空间均为 Hilbert 空间的复形. 在每个层次上, 都有两个 Hilbert 空间: 基空间 $W^k$ 和定义域空间, 后者记为 $V^k$. 由于假设微分 $d^k$ 是闭的, 定义域空间 $V^k$ 配备图范数后就是 Hilbert 空间:}
\[
\|v\|_{V^k}^2=\|v\|_{W^k}^2+\|d^k v\|_{W^{k+1}}^2.
\]

source_text: {However, the Hilbert complex $(W,d)$ contains more information than its domain complex $(V,d)$. From the former you can construct the latter, but knowing only the latter you cannot infer the spaces $W^k$ or the $W^k$ norm. Besides Hilbert cochain complexes, just defined, we can, of course, also talk about Hilbert chain complexes which differ only in that the indices decrease.}
translated_text: {然而, Hilbert 复形 $(W,d)$ 比其定义域复形 $(V,d)$ 包含更多信息. 由前者可构造后者, 但仅知道后者, 无法推知空间 $W^k$ 或 $W^k$ 范数. 除刚才定义的 Hilbert 上链复形外, 当然也可讨论 Hilbert 链复形; 唯一的区别是指标递减.}

source_text: {As we did previously for complexes, we denote the range and null space of the differential by $\mathcal B^k=d^{k-1}V^{k-1}$ and $\mathcal Z^k=\mathcal N(d^k)$, the spaces of coboundaries and cocycles. We have $\mathcal B^k\subset\mathcal Z^k$ and the quotients are the cohomology spaces $\mathcal H^k=\mathcal Z^k/\mathcal B^k$. The cycle spaces are always closed, but the boundary spaces may or may not be. A Hilbert complex is called \emph{closed} if the range $\mathcal B$ is closed in $W$ for all $k$. This holds if and only if $\mathcal B$ is complete in the $W$ norm. Since the $V$ norm on $\mathcal Z$ coincides with the $W$ norm there, it is equivalent to require that $\mathcal B$ is complete with respect to the $V$ norm, or that $\mathcal B$ is closed in $V$. A Hilbert complex is called \emph{Fredholm} if the cohomology spaces are finite dimensional, i.e., the boundary spaces are finite codimensional inside the cycle spaces. Most of the complexes we encounter will be Fredholm. In view of Theorem~\ref{thm:finite-codimension-closed-range}, a Fredholm complex is closed.}
translated_text: {与前面对复形所作的一样, 将微分的像与零空间分别记为 $\mathcal B^k=d^{k-1}V^{k-1}$ 和 $\mathcal Z^k=\mathcal N(d^k)$, 即上边界链空间和闭上链空间. 有 $\mathcal B^k\subset\mathcal Z^k$, 其商为上同调空间 $\mathcal H^k=\mathcal Z^k/\mathcal B^k$. 闭链空间总是闭的, 但边界链空间可能闭, 也可能不闭. 若对所有 $k$, 像空间 $\mathcal B$ 在 $W$ 中闭, 则称 Hilbert 复形是\emph{闭的}. 这当且仅当 $\mathcal B$ 关于 $W$ 范数完备. 由于 $\mathcal Z$ 上的 $V$ 范数与该空间上的 $W$ 范数相同, 等价地可以要求 $\mathcal B$ 关于 $V$ 范数完备, 或要求 $\mathcal B$ 在 $V$ 中闭. 若上同调空间为有限维, 即边界链空间在闭链空间中为有限余维, 则称 Hilbert 复形为 \emph{Fredholm} 复形. 我们遇到的大多数复形都是 Fredholm 的. 由 Theorem~\ref{thm:finite-codimension-closed-range}, Fredholm 复形是闭的.}

source_text:
{If $(W,d)$ is a Hilbert complex, then $d^{k-1}$ is a closed densely defined operator from $W^{k-1}$ to $W^k$, so its adjoint, which we denote by $d_k^*$, is a closed densely defined operator from $W^k$ to $W^{k-1}$. We denote its domain by $V_k^*$, a dense subset of $W^k$ which is, in general, quite different from $V^k$. We set $\mathcal Z_k^*=\mathcal N(d_k^*)$ and $\mathcal B_k^*=\mathcal R(d_{k+1}^*)$. Thus Theorem~\ref{thm:adjoint-kernel-range-orthogonality} gives}
\[
\mathcal B^\perp=\mathcal Z^*,\quad\mathcal Z^\perp=\overline{\mathcal B}^*,\quad\mathcal B^{*\perp}=\mathcal Z,\quad\mathcal Z^{*\perp}=\overline{\mathcal B}.
\]
translated_text:
{若 $(W,d)$ 为 Hilbert 复形, 则 $d^{k-1}$ 是从 $W^{k-1}$ 到 $W^k$ 的闭的稠密定义算子, 因而其伴随 (记为 $d_k^*$) 是从 $W^k$ 到 $W^{k-1}$ 的闭的稠密定义算子. 记其定义域为 $V_k^*$, 它是 $W^k$ 的稠密子集, 一般与 $V^k$ 很不相同. 令 $\mathcal Z_k^*=\mathcal N(d_k^*)$, $\mathcal B_k^*=\mathcal R(d_{k+1}^*)$. 因此由 Theorem~\ref{thm:adjoint-kernel-range-orthogonality}, 有}
\[
\mathcal B^\perp=\mathcal Z^*,\quad\mathcal Z^\perp=\overline{\mathcal B}^*,\quad\mathcal B^{*\perp}=\mathcal Z,\quad\mathcal Z^{*\perp}=\overline{\mathcal B}.
\]
